resource: Shared creature and player chase path expansions in one Channel per 50 ms window
allocation_impact: One unit per actual expansion. Pending creature requests run by deadline then ExactActorRef, then player chase. Reserve 16,384 units while player chase waits; unused reserve returns in the same window. A request without 1,024 units available waits without failing.
boundary_tests: hard maximum + 1 waits or is refused without partial mutation
